entry.author: Callaghan Innovation
entry.summary:
Check out our latest video to hear from Dr. Johnson Witehira and James Prier, the masterminds behind Paku ltd, a Kiwi company that creates award-winning children's toys through a Māori lens.

Their unique kaupapa has earned them a spot as finalists in this year's Kamupene Māori o Te Tau - Māori Company of the Year Award of the prestigious NZ Hi-Tech Awards. We're proud to sponsor this year’s category in partnership with Poutama Trust.
